title: Pagination
excerpt: Pagination MCP uses [cursor based pagination] for all list operations that can return large result sets. [cursor based pagination]: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025 11 25/server/utilities/pagination Overview Instead of offset based pagination (page 1, page 2, etc.), MCP uses opaque cursor tokens.
